heading: Wednesday, June 7, 2023
topLine: AlphaDev finds faster small-sort and hashing routines now shipped in libc++ and Abseil.

items.headline: AlphaDev finds faster small-sort and hashing routines now shipped in libc++ and Abseil
items.summary: Google DeepMind's reinforcement-learning agent AlphaDev searched assembly instructions directly and found sorting routines up to 70% faster for short sequences (about 1.7% for sequences over 250,000 elements) plus a hashing routine 30% faster in the 9-16 byte range. Published in Nature and merged into LLVM's libc++, the first change to that part of the library in over a decade; the gains are concentrated on very small inputs.
